verdict.rationale: Stack Equity stores underlying documents alongside the cap table (uploaded repurchase and conversion agreements, recorded board consents). It also produces Excel and OCF exports and a pro forma explicitly aimed at legal teams and prospective investors, so diligence material can be assembled and shared manually. However, stakeholder dashboards only show each holder their own holdings, and there is no evidence of a permissioned data room for counsel or investors. The update FAQ also points customers to move to J.P. Morgan or Pulley, which raises doubt about continued equity support. Missing for 10: a dedicated data room, role-based or permissioned external sharing of cap table views and documents for counsel and investors, access controls and audit of external viewers, independent corroboration.
